summary: Since 2019 Nürnberg has closed several Altstadt streets to through traffic, adopted a 2021 Mobilitätsbeschluss that aims to cut street parking in favour of space for walking and greenery, and ended free all-day on-street parking in the Altstadt by 2022. The former Kaufhof garage closed with the store in June 2023 and reopened in November 2024 under the city's ownership, with Goldbeck running it ticketless. On the demand side, the Christkindlesmarkt was cancelled in 2020 and 2021 and has since drawn about two million visitors a year, VAG passenger numbers set records after the Deutschlandticket arrived, and footfall on the main shopping streets rose in 2025.

items.text: Nürnberg's traffic committee voted to close the Weinmarkt (as a trial), cut off through traffic on the Bergstraße and close the Maxbrücke to private cars in the Altstadt, with exceptions for buses, taxis and emergency vehicles. The local CSU criticised the plan for lacking an overall Altstadt concept.
items.source_title: CSU-Positionspapier forderte ein Gesamtkonzept, das über Sperrungen hinausgeht: Aktuelles Update & Umfrage: Autos sollen aus der Altstadt raus - Weinmarkt, Bergstraße und Maxbrücke betroffen - Nürnberg

items.text: The city council adopted the 'Mobilitätsbeschluss für Nürnberg' with a broad cross-party majority. It targets a rise in the share of trips made on foot, by bike and by public transport from 61% to about 68% by 2030. Its parking strategy is to reorganise parking in favour of pedestrians and greenery: neighbourhood garages with parking management, and fewer spaces on public streets.

A city flyer explained the switch of on-street parking management in the Altstadt, which the council's traffic committee had decided. All previously free spaces become mixed-use: permit holders park without limit, everyone else pays and is time-limited, and the control hours run 8:00 to 22:00. Stated goals include more long-stay parkers using the city-centre garages and fewer on-street spaces in the Altstadt. Areas B and C had already switched, area A was due from August 2021, and all areas were due by the end of 2021.
items.source_title: Umstellung der Parkraumbewirtschaftung in der Altstadt (Stadt Nürnberg, Verkehrsplanungsamt, flyer)

items.text: Citing a city press release, a local paper reported that the Altstadt switch was finished in February 2022, after zones A to C in 2021 and zone D (south of the Pegnitz) from December 2021. Non-residents can now park on the former free spaces only by paying, for up to four hours, while residents with permits park free.
items.source_title: Parken in Nürnberg: Neue Regelungen für Bewohnerparken

items.text: Bavaria's interior ministry decided to keep the cap on resident parking permits at 30.70 euros a year, after putting the question off in 2023. Nürnberg was reported as favouring a higher cap.
items.source_title: Parkgebühren für Anwohner in Franken - Aufatmen nach Forderung höherer Preise

items.text: The Galeria Kaufhof store on Königstraße closed in June 2023. The city acquired the building, which has a 220-space garage on Breite Gasse, in October 2024. Temporary uses began in September 2025, and in January 2026 the council approved a selection process for a long-term use running to summer 2028.
items.source_title: Kaufhof in der Königstraße – Nürnberg – deine Stadt

items.text: The former Kaufhof garage (Frauengasse, entrance via Kornmarkt), closed since June 2023, reopened for the Christmas market season with 220 spaces. Goldbeck Parking Services runs it for the city. It works ticketless with automatic number-plate recognition and card-only pay machines. Short stays are priced at 5 euros per 24 hours.
items.source_title: Nachrichten aus dem Rathaus: Ehemaliges Kaufhof-Parkhaus wiedereröffnet

items.text: Owner HIH Invest appointed PARK ONE to run the underground garage below Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz (268 spaces, including EV charging). The lease was due to start once renovation finished in spring 2025.
items.source_title: HIH Invest gewinnt PARK ONE als neuen Betreiber für Tiefgarage in Nürnberg

items.text: N-ERGIE opened its 'Parkhaus der Zukunft' at Sandreuth (outside the centre) with 338 spaces and 128 EV charge points. Spaces can be reserved by app, and number-plate cameras assign spaces on entry. It is part of a network with seven other Nürnberg and Fürth garages, where prices in outer garages can drop when city-centre air pollution is high.

N-ERGIE and infra fürth announced a federally co-funded project to fit six Nürnberg and four Fürth garages outside the city centres with 3,100 occupancy sensors and 370 charge points. It also included a platform whose prices could vary with traffic and air pollution, with completion planned for the end of 2020.
items.source_title: N-Ergie und Infrafürth planen Dynamische Preise in öffentlichen Parkhäusern

items.text: N-ERGIE listed EV charge points at Nürnberg park-and-ride sites: 36 at Herrnhütte, 32 at Langwasser-Süd and 26 at Am Wegfeld. Parking there is free with a valid public-transport ticket.
items.source_title: Parkplätze und Parken in Nürnberg: Unsere Tipps

items.text: The city's parking page describes an Altstadt guidance system covering about 5,300 spaces in 19 city-centre garages, with occupancy updated every 15 minutes. It puts on-street fees at 2.50 euros an hour inside the walls and 2 euros outside, and says all on-street spaces can be paid with the PayByPhone app.
The Christkindlesmarkt was cancelled for a second year in a row after Bavaria called off all Christmas markets because of the COVID-19 situation, following the 2020 cancellation.
items.source_title: Nürnberger Christkindlesmarkt 2021 abgesagt - Schuld ist Corona

items.text: The city reported about two million visitors at the 2024 Christkindlesmarkt, which closed on 24 December.
items.source_title: Nachrichten aus dem Rathaus: Christkindlesmarkt 2024 mit rund zwei Millionen Gästen

items.text: VAG, the Nürnberg transport operator, carried a record of over 160 million passengers in 2024, up from 154 million in 2023. Subscriptions reached 281,000, of which 259,000 were Deutschlandtickets: more than 180% above April 2023, the month before the ticket was introduced.

The city reported rising pedestrian counts in 2025 from its laser counters. Königstraße had about 14 million passers-by (+2.6%), Karolinenstraße about 13.2 million (+3%) and Ludwigsplatz about 8 million (+6.9%), while Breite Gasse recorded about 6.6 million despite ongoing works.
items.source_title: Passantenfrequenz 2025: Positive Entwicklung in der Innenstadt
